zh.title: 可编程、预算受限的多智能体工作流——从你已有的接缝中生长出来

zh.title: 领域驱动设计：回归本质的工程实践
zh.description: 本文回归 DDD 的本质动机，结合 Nestify 项目的完整源码，逐层拆解领域驱动设计的核心概念——不只是"怎么做"，更是"为什么这么做"。

zh.author: A3S Lab

zh.title: 沉睡三十年的标准：HTTP 402、生成式 UI 与智能体原生软件的时代
zh.description: HTTP 402 在 1996 年被定义，标注为「保留待用」。三十年后，AI 智能体范式终于让它变得真实可用。本文从最根本的问题出发，面向传统软件用户解释：当智能体成为软件的主要消费者，机器可协商的支付协议和生成式 UI 正在悄然重写我们对软件的所有假设。

zh.title: 你的 nginx 在扼杀 AI 服务——为什么需要重新设计流量层
zh.description: Web 时代的网关建立在四个假设上。AI 服务打破了所有四个。这篇文章从流量的物理现实出发，推导出 AI 原生网关必须具备的五种能力，以及为什么现有工具无法提供它们。
zh.author: A3S Lab

en.author: A3S Lab

en.title: The 30-Year Sleeping Standard: HTTP 402, Generative UI, and the Coming Age of Agent-Native Software
en.description: HTTP 402 was defined in 1996 and marked "reserved for future use." Thirty years later, the AI agent paradigm is finally making it relevant. This article starts from the ground up to explain how agentic software, machine-negotiated payments, and generative UI are quietly dismantling everything we assumed about how software works.
en.author: A3S Lab

en.title: Your nginx Is Killing Your AI Service — Why You Need to Redesign the Traffic Layer
en.description: Web-era gateways were built on four assumptions. AI services break all four. This article starts from the physical reality of traffic and derives the five capabilities an AI-native gateway must have — and why existing tools cannot provide them.
en.author: A3S Lab

en.title: A Privacy LLM Inference Engine That Runs on $10 Hardware
